purpose: Independently determine canonical HUNT department/category before any product becomes a shelf candidate.
invariants: Current HUNT department/category never counts as positive evidence for its own validation.
Supplier taxonomy is evidence, never sole authority.
Explicit product type outranks generic audience words such as women, men, ladies or male.
Explicit gender contradiction blocks a gender-only department unless the product is clearly unisex.
One product has exactly one canonical department and one canonical category.
No cross-category filler to improve shelf density.
Ambiguous or unsupported placement returns REVIEW/UNKNOWN and never reaches canonical shelf activation.
Stylist may rank within a passed rail but may not override placement.
Placement PASS does not imply Product Truth, shipping, stock, profit or checkout readiness.
Official supplier taxonomy may support KEEP only when product identity is observed in a pre-mapped supplier category.

classification_layers.rule: High-precision explicit product-type evidence; current category never counts as evidence.
High-precision validation rules for Beauty, Kids, Kitchen, Tech, Sports, Pets, Camping, Travel, Home and other major categories; unsafe cross-category suggestions abstain to REVIEW.
Use independent official supplier taxonomy/attributes to resolve UNKNOWN items; exact mappings support KEEP, conflicts go to REVIEW, and broad mappings abstain.
High-overlap rails separate product family from subtype; feature/context words cannot override primary product family. SAFE_MOVE remains shadow-only.

requirements: product_id observed in official supplier category during fresh read-only refresh
supplier category id must be mapped unambiguously to the same canonical HUNT rail
explicit product-type or gender conflict still overrides taxonomy support
never_allowed: auto MOVE from supplier taxonomy alone

local_review_judge.rule: Judge proposal never creates PASS, KEEP or MOVE. It only prioritizes REVIEW.

supplier_taxonomy_rule: Exact supplier taxonomy may support KEEP only when the product identity is observed in a pre-approved exact mapping. Broad/unmapped categories remain UNKNOWN. Cross-rail conflicts are REVIEW only. Supplier taxonomy never auto-MOVEs a product.
overlap_rule: High-overlap rails run Product Placement Stage6 before final placement decision. SAFE_MOVE is shadow-only; REVIEW/UNKNOWN/HOLD fail closed.
